settings.heading: Redefining Comfort for Modern Indian Homes
settings.text: KJ Enterprises was founded on a single belief: your home deserves only the finest. We work directly with master weavers to bring hotel-grade luxury to everyday Indian homes — from the crisp coolness of 400TC bedsheets to the gentle warmth of our cloud-soft comforters, vivid cushion covers, and beautifully draping curtains.
settings.feat_1_desc: No middlemen — we partner directly with skilled artisans for honest luxury pricing.
settings.feat_2_desc: Natural fibres that breathe with your body and keep allergens away.
settings.feat_3_desc: Sustainable packaging and non-toxic dyes safe for your family and planet.
settings.feat_4_desc: Rigorous durability tests ensure our textiles stay beautiful for years.

settings.heading: Quality That You Can Feel
settings.text: We believe in transparency — from the source of our cotton to the hands that weave each thread. Every KJ product undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure it meets our exacting standards before it reaches your home.
